sents.zh: 商朝是中国很早的一个朝代。
sents.en: The Shang was one of China’s very early dynasties.

sents.zh: 那时候的人已经会写字了。
sents.en: People of that time could already write.

sents.zh: 不过他们不在纸上写，因为那时候还没有纸。
sents.en: But they did not write on paper, because there was no paper yet.

sents.zh: 他们把字写在动物的骨头上。
sents.en: They wrote the characters on animal bones.

sents.zh: 这些骨头又大又白，上面可以写很多字。
sents.en: These bones were large and white, and many characters could be written on them.

sents.zh: 商朝的人相信天上有神。
sents.en: Shang people believed there were gods in the sky.

sents.zh: 所以他们有问题的时候，就问神。
sents.en: So when they had a question, they asked the gods.

sents.zh: 他们问：“今天的天气好吗？”
sents.en: They asked: "Will the weather be good today?"

sents.zh: 他们也问：“这次出去，会不会好？”
sents.en: They also asked: "Will this journey go well?"

sents.zh: 问完以后，他们用火烧骨头。
sents.en: After asking, they burned the bone with fire.

sents.zh: 骨头上会出现一些线，他们看线来知道答案。
sents.en: Lines would appear on the bone, and they read the lines for the answer.

sents.zh: 然后他们把问题和答案都写在这块骨头上。
sents.en: Then they wrote both the question and the answer on that bone.

sents.zh: 这些字是中国最早的字，已经有三千多年了。
sents.en: These are China’s earliest characters, more than three thousand years old.

sents.zh: 很久以后，人们在地里发现了这些骨头。
sents.en: Long afterwards, people found these bones in the ground.

sents.zh: 所以今天我们还能看到商朝人写的字。
sents.en: So today we can still see the characters the Shang people wrote.
